note: Every --we-* knob is declared on :host (src/css/variables.css) and reads the shared --base-* contract (@keenmate/base-css-variables 2.0) with a light-dark() fallback, so a :root theme reaches it in both schemes; set --we-* on the element itself. The --we-context-menu-* inputs are never declared: they pass through to core's menu (--_km-menu-*).
